observations:
Coverage: 12 screenshots, each showing a different one of the 12 listed reports selected, in list order (1.PNG Peg Board Day Sheet, 2 Daily Journal, 3 Production Report, 4 Collection Report, 5 Deposit Slip, 6 Scheduled Production = left column; 7 Routing Slip, 8 Progress Notes, 9 Production Analysis Report, 10 Daily Audit, 11 Claims Printed, 12 Special Transaction Report = right column). The selected radio of every screenshot was confirmed from the pixels. There are no popups, expanded dropdowns, scrolled second views or foreign screens, so the contents of every SELECT / SEARCH picker dialog and of the two dropdown lists (Amount on Special Transaction Report, Fee Schedule To Compare on Production Report) are NOT documented by these screenshots.

Screen chrome (identical in all 12): dark title bar with 'Daily Reports' at the left and 'PGID :2829 / OID :108' followed by a white printer icon at the far right. Blue sub-header 'SELECT REPORT' over the left panel and 'REPORT CRITERIA' over the right panel; the right end of the REPORT CRITERIA bar holds the grey-styled CLEAR CRITERIA button (refresh icon). A splitter / collapse handle with three vertical dots sits between the two panels. The bottom action bar of the criteria panel holds PRINT / PREVIEW (printer icon) and ADD TO MY FAVORITES (plus icon), both blue.

Report list: 12 radio items in a 2-column x 6-row grid; the dark panel below the grid is empty (checked pixel by pixel), so the list is not scrollable or clipped.

Text-rendering caveat: the bold dark section-header font draws a capital G almost exactly like a C at this resolution (the partly visible footer message suggests the page was captured at 75% browser zoom), so the pixels look like 'OFFICE/CROUP', 'DATE RANCE', 'CROUP BY', 'PROCRESS NOTES TO PRINT', 'BUT MISSINC', 'CATECORY', 'CODE/CATECORY', 'PATIENT NAME RANCE'. The greyed 'GROUP BATCH CHECKS' header on Deposit Slip and the mixed-case labels ('Office Group', 'Group By') show a clear G, so all of these are transcribed with G. The date digits '11' also render like 'TI' (the value is 11/21/2026).

Recurring patterns: PRINT FORMAT (PDF | Excel, default PDF) is on 11 of 12 reports - missing only on Routing Slip. REPORT FORMAT (Detail | Summary) appears only on Daily Journal, Production Report (Detail greyed, Summary selected), Collection Report and Claims Printed; Production Analysis Report has ANALYSIS BY in that slot. OFFICE/GROUP (Office | Office Group radios, default Office, plus an unlabelled read-only box showing 108 = the current OID with a SELECT button) is on all 12; Office Group is greyed only on Routing Slip. A PROVIDER picker (default ALL) is on 10 reports - Production Report and Collection Report have none - and a User picker is added (section title PROVIDER/USER) on Daily Journal, Deposit Slip and Special Transaction Report; Progress Notes labels its provider row 'Preferred Provider'. Every date field shows 11/21/2026 (the capture day, i.e. the default is today); Peg Board Day Sheet has a single Report Date instead of a Start Date / End Date range. A date-basis radio precedes the range on Daily Journal (Transaction Date | Created Date), Deposit Slip (Transaction Date | Payment Date), Progress Notes (DOS Date | Created On Date | Appointment Date) and Special Transaction Report (Transaction Date | Service Date). Apart from the office box (108), the read-only picker boxes (grey fill + blue SELECT) default to ALL, except EXCLUDE PATIENT TYPE and PAYMENT/ADJ CODES on Special Transaction Report which default to 'None'. A small 'Page Break' checkbox sits alone in the right half of the grouping row on Daily Journal, Production Report, Collection Report and Daily Audit and is greyed in every screenshot (grouping = None in all of them). Button icons: building icon for office / codes / payment types / payment-adj codes / insurance plans / code-category; single-person icon for provider / operatory / category / carrier(s); person-plus icon for user and exclude patient type; magnifier for SEARCH; circle-slash for NONE.

Disabled states were confirmed by pixel colour: disabled labels are mid-grey (RGB 161) against black for enabled ones; read-only / disabled boxes are grey (220,223,226) against (241,241,241) for editable fields. Controls greyed in the captured default state (what enables them is not shown): Show AR and Page Break (Daily Journal); Detail, Page Break, Include Z-Codes and the Fee Schedule To Compare dropdown (Production Report); Page Break (Collection Report); CHECK TYPE and the whole GROUP BATCH CHECKS block (Deposit Slip); Office Group (Routing Slip); Appointment Date and APPOINTMENTS TO INCLUDE (Progress Notes); the CARRIER SELECT button (Production Analysis Report); Page Break (Daily Audit); Age Range From / To and the amount value box (Special Transaction Report).

Truncation: the criteria area has a fixed height (about 481 px in every screenshot) with the action bar pinned below it and no scrollbar is ever drawn. Daily Journal (2.PNG) is visibly clipped - its GROUP BY row is cut by the action bar - and Special Transaction Report (12.PNG) fills the area exactly with its last row flush against (and about 2-3 px short at) the action bar, so both are flagged possibly_truncated; in both cases the overflow is only a few pixels, which is consistent with the visible row being the last one, but hidden rows cannot be ruled out. The other ten reports show blank space under their last section.

Footer: only 2.PNG shows a sliver of the page footer, and only the top 3-4 pixel rows of the glyphs are visible, so it cannot be read reliably. Best reading: '© 2026 Planet DDS | Privacy Policy | ... [?]' in black (Privacy Policy in link blue, followed by further unreadable text ending in digits) and, in red at the right, 'You have zoomed ... to 75%. This page is best viewed if zoomed to 100% [?]'. It is browser-zoom chrome of the host page, not report criteria.

Verification: third-reader pass over the original PNGs and enlarged crops. Readers A and B agreed on every report, section, control, option, default and enabled state (151 controls); their only differences were descriptive (SELECT icon wording, the label given to the Routing Slip info icon, the wording of the unreadable footer). A pixel-cluster sweep of every criteria panel found no control outside those listed here.

supplement_unresolved.question: No vendor description of this report was found (only a glossary entry). What the Provider picker filters and what the single Report Date selects are unverified; the document reconstructs the report from comparable systems only.

What unlocks Show AR? It is greyed in our capture and in every vendor screenshot seen (Detail, Office, any transaction mix); the enabling rule is unknown. On the Executive Summary (Monthly Reports) the same option appends Total A/R; whether it does the same here is not stated.
What does Include Resp. Party Type add? "The responsible-party type on each line" is unverified.
Exact PATIENT TYPE rule: does General mean non-ortho patients only and Ortho ortho-flagged patients only? Unverified.

Transaction Date definition conflict inside the vendor texts: the editable ledger / posting date versus the date entered. Affects the date basis of Daily Journal, Deposit Slip and Special Transaction Report.

The criteria shown for PRODUCTION BY = Category and PRODUCTION BY = Carrier were not seen; category / carrier pickers are expected but unverified. The document says REPORT FORMAT Detail is selectable only for PRODUCTION BY = Provider, but that cannot be checked for Category and Carrier, whose states were not seen.

Is the SORT BY section (Transaction Date / Patient Lastname) tied to PRODUCTION BY = Provider or to REPORT FORMAT = Detail? The state was seen only with Detail selected. The default of SORT BY and of the PROVIDERS picker, and the state of Page Break and Fee Schedule To Compare under PRODUCTION BY = Provider, are not documented. An older (2016) sample of Production by Provider in the Summary format prints a compare-fee column, so the greying of Include UCR / Include Z-Codes may belong to REPORT FORMAT = Detail rather than to PRODUCTION BY = Provider.
With GROUP BY = Carrier: does the Page Break checkbox get a carrier label and does a carrier picker appear? Was Page Break by Provider ticked automatically or by the user in the sample?
Fee Schedule To Compare: the value list is not documented; the greyed default is presumably just the first fee schedule in the tenant list (unverified).

What enables Page Break (greyed while COLLECTION BY = None)? Do provider / carrier / code pickers appear for the other COLLECTION BY choices? The By Provider output echoes a Provider criterion in its footer, but the base screen has no provider picker.
REPORT FORMAT Summary is unverified, and whether COLLECTION BY Provider uses the transaction provider or the allocation provider is not stated.
What enables the GROUP BATCH CHECKS header checkbox (greyed in our capture with only Cash ticked)? Presumably the Check payment type - not stated. Its effect on the output is unverified.

Which dates does DATE RANGE select - appointment dates for scheduled production and posting dates for actual production? The document defines the three figures (scheduled, actual, estimated production) but not the date basis, and no vendor screenshot of this criteria screen or of the output is cited.

Scope question: the Routing Slip can also be printed from the Patient Overview (Print Reports > Routing Slip) and from the Scheduler (right-click Print > Routing Slip), the latter with its own options - Current appointment only / all appointments in the day for the current location / for all locations, an Appointment Date and Include Completed Procedures. They are not part of the Daily Reports criteria screen; decide whether the new module covers them.

Block appointments for events reportedly produce no slip - seen only as a search-result summary of a vendor article, not read in full. Does the appointment selection (DATE RANGE / Provider / Operatory) skip them?

SORT BY option spelling: our transcription could not tell whether the separator in the options Provider (Last Name) – Appointment Date and Operatory – Appointment Date is an en dash (as transcribed) or a plain hyphen; the document only repeats our transcription, so the exact legacy spelling stays open.

Does Missing unlock the Appointment Date basis and APPOINTMENTS TO INCLUDE (unverified - both are greyed under Detail)? What is their state under Unsigned? Does ALL list every appointment with its note status (unverified)? The document glosses the DOS Date / Created On Date basis as the note date of service / the note entry date, from our own transcription only - no vendor source is given.

Does ANALYSIS BY = Carrier enable the CARRIER picker and grey the CATEGORY picker? Only our default-state capture suggests it; there is no vendor source. Is the CATEGORY list the 14 categories of the SEARCH CODE dialog (unverified)?
Which provider does the Provider picker / column mean? The vendor article says the Preferred Provider and also defines it as the provider on the transaction date (conflict).
Page Break is greyed while GROUP BY = None and is ticked automatically for GROUP BY = Provider: can the user untick it then, or does it stay locked? Not stated.

Transaction in Ledger: one vendor text says a posted procedure counts only when its code is flagged Visit Code, another that the report shows transactions that are Ledger Codes - must a code carry both flags to count?

No vendor description of Claims Printed exists: the date basis of DATE RANGE (printed, created or sent date), whether e-claims are included, and what Detail / Summary and the Provider filter do are all inferred.
Amount dropdown: values other than All Amount are not documented, nor when the amount value box beside it unlocks.

EXCLUDE PATIENT TYPE: the vendor article describes it as including only the selected patient types, which conflicts with the label - is it an include or an exclude filter? The criteria block printed at the top of the PDF output labels it Excluded Pat Types.

Do the Age Range From / To boxes unlock when Age Range is ticked (not stated)? The default of the hidden Sort By row is not documented. Is the Category list of CODE/CATEGORY the 14 SEARCH CODE categories (unverified)?

Picker dialogs the document does not describe: Provider, User, Operatory, Payment Types, Carrier / Carriers, Category, Exclude Patient Type, Payment/Adj Codes, Insurance Plans/Sub Types, the patient SEARCH, and the Office Group variant of the office picker. For SEARCH CODE only INCLUDE ALL, CATEGORY, SORT BY and the dual list are listed - whether it also has SEARCH TEXT / CLEAR SEARCH, >> / << and APPLY / CANCEL like SEARCH OFFICES is not stated.

Older build: before October 2021 Daily Reports also listed Executive Summary and Executive Summary by Provider (now Monthly Reports > Executive Summary) and Appointment Pull Chart List (not in the current list). Not added here; confirm they are out of scope for this category.

The UPDATE MY FAVORITES relabel is recorded on Deposit Slip and Special Transaction Report, and the Office / Office Group semantics on Deposit Slip and Daily Audit - the reports whose vendor screenshots / articles are cited. Do both hold for every report screen of the category (the document presents them as general)?

Rights: the vendor lists Reports - Daily Reports Screen Full Control (run) and View Only (see the report list and the parameters only). How View Only shows on the criteria screen (PRINT / PREVIEW hidden or disabled?) is not described.

Provider means different things per report (provider on the ledger line, provider of record on the procedure, transaction provider, preferred provider). For Collection Report, Scheduled Production, Routing Slip, Production Analysis Report, Claims Printed and Peg Board Day Sheet the document gives no vendor statement of which provider the picker or grouping uses. The vendor glossary also says that Provider in reports means the patient's preferred dentist, not the treating clinician, which does not match the per-report meanings recorded here.
The vendor end-of-day training deck (a 17 MB PDF) and three report webinars could not be read; they may show further criteria states of the Daily Reports screens.
